# Draft:Suraj Tiwari

Suraj Tiwari (born March 10, 1974) is an Indian entrepreneur, businessman, advocate, central public notary, and was in NSUI, known for his contributions to the infrastructure and construction sector. He is the founder of Vindhyarise Constructions (OPC) Private Limited, a company engaged in infrastructure development projects in India.
Early Life and Education
Suraj Tiwari was born on March 10, 1974, in India. Details about his early life and education remain limited in publicly available sources.
Career
Tiwari established Vindhyarise Constructions (OPC) Private Limited, focusing on real estate and infrastructure development. Under his leadership, the company has been involved in various construction projects. In addition to his business endeavors, he serves as an advocate and central public notary. He has also been actively involved in politics and served as the NSUI President.
Business Ventures
In addition to Vindhyarise Constructions, Tiwari has been associated with several business initiatives in the infrastructure and real estate sectors. His company aims to contribute to urban development and modernization through construction and civil engineering projects.
Personal Life
Suraj Tiwari is married and has one daughter and one son.
